verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a one-click sweep that clears non-important emails at once, plus plain-English AI filters that automatically label, star or archive mail. A hands-on user reports clearing a weeks-old backlog in about 10 minutes. Evidence for broader bulk operations is thin. Missing for 10: documented multi-select/batch actions on arbitrary sets of threads, the AI assistant performing bulk actions across many existing emails on request, scale limits or undo for bulk actions, and detailed docs beyond marketing lines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
'In 10min I cleared my inbox which I was postponing for a few weeks.'
